profile.headline: Sr Software Engineer III at Amazon Web Services (AWS)
profile.summary:
Striving to create, design, and use elegant frameworks, smart development pipelines, automated systems, and analysis tools for available, usable, and secure cloud services with modern methods such as:

* Code components, dependency management (injection), dependency bundles (modules), test driven development
* Role based access control, token/claims based identity, and secret/certificate management for security
* Asynchronous distributed logging, metrics, monitoring and service performance analysis
* Safe roll-out for high global service availability

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Current Team: Cloud and Enterprise Identity. 

Working to enable cloud based Identity services with Azure Active Directory, specifically building highly available, secure web services using .NET WebAPI (OData), Azure Storage and Messaging; Service Fabric; Document DB (Cosmos DB); RBAC (Role based access control), Token/Claims based Identity,  Azure KeyVault (secret and certificate management), ARM deployment templates; safe deployment; distributed metrics, logging and service monitoring/analysis/diagnostics; service fault injection.

Lead designer of data access abstraction web service that uses OData API standards, inject-able *Service and *Actor abstractions for business/data logic, and a modularized code structure allowing the .NET service to be hosted in IIS or OWIN, authorized with tokens or client certs, diagnosed and monitored with simple local or full featured distributed traces.

Lead contributor to providing the team with reusable code components through structured libraries, nuget publishing, and dependency management schemes (Dependency Injection, Dependency Bundles/Modules) leading to better development cycles (local hosting), test-ability (Mocks), test driven development and ultimately test coverage (more services using already tested components and mocks).

Previous Team: Global Product Engineering: 

Building Xbox One localization content pipelines and processes for the global portfolio. I integrated Machine Learning into our localization pipeline, and designed and built processes for task management, scheduling, compliance, and KPI monitoring.

On the side: Office Add-In development, DAX, Power Pivot, Typescript, NodeJS, MDX, OLAP, Data Visualization

positions.title: Engineer/Owner
positions.description:
An entrepreneurial shot at working on my own.

* Configure & maintain web hosting platforms: Apache, MySQL, Java Servlet Container (Tomcat), QMail, Daemontools, SMF on Solaris & Linux
* Developing web apps & services within Grails framework: Groovy, Java, Apache, Tomcat
* JS: jQuery + Plugins; YUI3
* LESS/CSS: Bootstrap

Public Sites: 
* http://randys-jewelry.com: Load, display and manage 30,000 item catalog for local business.
* http://healthyharvestcooperative.com: Wordpress based ecommerce site for local business.

Private Contracts: 
* Duro Flex USA: Migrate 18 years of legacy business data and build new web tool to manage raw material & product inventory, customer orders, floor work-orders, invoices, and general ledger accounting. Current largest table: 180,000 rows.

positions.title: SET (YouTube)
positions.description:
Making sure the kids get paid through YouTube's advanced revenue sharing program. 

* Distributed Platform in Python / C++ /  Protocol Buffers: Terabytes of data, 10,000 machines within Google's 'big data' compute and storage platform.
* Created & maintained multiple full staging environments for testing & releasing 20+ processes.
* Coded distributed tools to verify patch environment against live / last known good environment.
* Worked to certify code test/release process as SOX (Sarbanes-Oxley) compliant.
* Created tools to visualize pipeline status & progress.

positions.title: Tools SDE (Xbox LIVE Arcade/Marketplace)
positions.description:
Xbox LIVE Marketplace tool developer tasked to increase productivity through the life cycle of the New Xbox Experience:

* Released Xbox Originals on Xbox 360.
* Released Xbox 360 Games on Demand.
* Built productivity tools with various technologies: Xml, i18n, Xbox XDK, .NET Forms, ASP.NET, Web Services, SQL Databases.

Xbox Live Marketplace Tools and utilities:
* Title Manager (Win C#): Manage localization & platform resources over title's development life cycle.
* POM Manager (Win C#): Manage Point of Sale Tokens.
* Offer Search (ASP.NET C#): Search and enumerate 'live' Marketplace offers.
* Offer Edit & other utilities (Console C#): Batch process offer files.
* XBL Arcade & Games on Demand XDK Integration via XLast tool (COM C++)

Lead Xbox Live Arcade platform tool support roles through platform updates and 1-4 game releases per week:

* Launched with Xbox 360, integrated into the Dashboard.
* Test lead for biannual Xbox Live Arcade platform releases.
* Test lead and release manager the Xbox Live Arcade Networking library (XANet).
* Supported test vendors with test automation tools, technical support and deep dive bug research.
* Increased productivity of release managers by providing custom localization tools.
* Developed Xbox 360 XDK applications: Arcade Sample and Arcade Validate.
* Integrated XInput into XBL Arcade dev-kit before official XDK integration.

positions.title: Lead Tool Programmer
positions.description:
Tools & Pipeline Lead:

Evil Dead Regeneration:
* Built an XML based Maya plug-in for tagging Maya resources with user defined data.
* Leveraged XML schema to validate input against user designed constraints.
* Built an XML based multi-target data compiler, extendable through shared library plug-ins.

Port Programmer:

Red Faction 2 [Game Cube]:
* Ported existing tool set & data from PS2 to the Game Cube.
* Ported and optimized streaming animation system.
* Optimized playability in physics simulations.

Summoner, A Goddess Reborn [Game Cube]:
* Implemented and supported an asynchronous file system library.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Programmer: MLB Slugfest 20-03

* Integrated the asynchronous file system used in Blitz 20-02.
* Completed menu screens in time for release.

Programmer: NFL Blitz 20-02

* Responsible for 'Create-a-Player', from building custom players to tracking records.
* Installed player models using the Renderware cross platform graphics API.
* Integrated custom, cross platform geometry solutions for the customized players.

Programmer: Tool & Technology Group

* Implemented BSP Tree compiler and render.

honors.title: Machine Learning Process Patent Filing
honors.description: Patent filed through Microsoft with respect to my working group's implementation of machine learning algorithms in our data processing pipeline.

honors.title: Microsoft Practice of Machine Learning Conference Poster Entry
honors.description: Poster entry presented describing my working group's implementation of machine learning algorithms in our data processing pipeline.
honors.issuer: Issued by Microsoft Practice of Machine Learning Conference · Jun 2014
